typographyMeta.fontNote: Platform system fonts: Roboto on Android, SF Pro on iOS, the platform's native Arabic face. No bundled faces in this phase. Sizes are dp.

shadows.name: raised-light
shadows.purpose: The ticket in Light: soft ambient drop plus a faint contact edge. Flutter blurRadius values carried as CSS blur.

motion.name: ticket-rise
motion.purpose: Cold-start entrance of the ticket; no fade. Skipped when a route transition brings the page in or reduced motion is on.

motion.name: fade-through-in

motion.purpose: Route transition between screens in this world (Login and Home). Skipped when system animations are off.

motion.name: action-swap
motion.purpose: Primary action label and arrow swap for the loading spinner.

components.name: Ticket
components.description: The one raised surface: stub, perforated tear line with side notches, working body.
components.html:
Driver Portal3 Nov 2026

Welcome back!

Sign in to your driver account
components.css: .ds-ticket-ground { background: #EEF1F7; padding: 24px 20px; } .ds-ticket { position: relative; max-width: 440px; margin: 0 auto; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #DCE3EF; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(17,21,34,0.07), 0 1px 4px rgba(17,21,34,0.04); font-family: system-ui, Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-ticket-stub { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 24px; } .ds-ticket-name { flex: 1; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 700; color: #111522; } .ds-ticket-date { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #303D59; } .ds-ticket-tear { position: relative; height: 0; margin: 0 18px; border-top: 1px solid transparent; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #DCE3EF 0 6px, transparent 6px 11px); background-size: 100% 1px; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding-top: 1px; } .ds-ticket-tear::before, .ds-ticket-tear::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -10px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #EEF1F7; border: 1px solid #DCE3EF; } .ds-ticket-tear::before { left: -29px; } .ds-ticket-tear::after { right: -29px; } .ds-ticket-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-ticket-title { margin: 0; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; color: #111522; } .ds-ticket-sub { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 400; color: #303D59; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width 56dp action with label and forward arrow (Light).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: #1E263B; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: system-ui, Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #252E46; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #2A3450; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1E263B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Dark)
components.description: The Dark scheme's action: pale slate fill, ink content.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark-ground { background: #1E263B; padding: 24px; } .ds-btn-primary-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: #DCE3EF; color: #111522; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: system-ui, Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { background: #CDD5E3; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:active { background: #C2CBDB; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DCE3EF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Loading)
components.description: Label swaps for a 22dp spinner; the button keeps its full action colors.
components.css: .ds-btn-loading { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 56px; background: #1E263B; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-btn-spinner { width: 22px; height: 22px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2.2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); border-top-color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-spin 0.9s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-spinner { animation-duration: 2.4s; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled, inset field with leading icon; 1.6dp focus outline in the focus role.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: system-ui, Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; color: #1E263B; } .ds-field-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px; background: #F6F8FB; border: 1px solid #7687A4; border-radius: 12px; color: #536684; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-field-box:hover { border-color: #536684; } .ds-field-box:focus-within { border-color: #1E263B; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.6px #1E263B; } .ds-field-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 16px 0; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 500; color: #111522; caret-color: #1E263B; }

components.description: Credential, offline, or unexpected failure; tinted surface, announced as a live region.

narrative.overview:
Every surface in this world reads like a fuel or weighbridge ticket handed to a driver: a stub that says who issued it and when, a perforated tear line, and a working body below. The paper is calm and the ink is official. The palette is the binding slate-navy six, built into two schemes that are designed separately rather than inverted: Light is a mist ground with a white ticket and ink action; Dark is an ink ground with a lifted navy ticket and a mist action. Depth comes from one soft shadow on the one raised surface and from fields that sit tonally below the ticket.

Density is low and deliberate. A surface shows the few things the driver needs, in a single centred column, at a size that survives a cab in daylight, a night shift, a large system font, and Arabic as much as English. Decoration is limited to the ticket's own anatomy: the notches, the perforation, and the route mark. Motion is short, purposeful, and always skipped when the system asks for reduced motion.

Scope: this world is adopted by Login only. Every other screen still renders the previous violet system (the earlier tokens in `AppColors` and the `AppSurfaces` roles) and migrates one screen at a time. This document governs only surfaces built on `AppPalette`.
keyCharacteristics: Official slate-navy only; no saturated hue anywhere except a muted error red.
Two built schemes with their own roles, read through `AppPalette`.
One raised surface per screen: the ticket, with one soft shadow.
Hairline borders; controls share one 12dp corner.
The perforated tear line with side notches is the signature.
Platform system fonts, no negative tracking, tabular figures for data.

rules.name: The Official Six Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is one of the six official values or a stated mix of them (mist is slate-100 toward white; slate-450 and slate-350 sit between slate-600 and slate-300). New colors are derived the same way, never picked freely.

rules.name: The Built Twice Rule
rules.body: Light and Dark are two designed role sets, not an inversion: the Dark field sinks to the ground color, and the Dark action turns pale. Screens read roles from `AppPalette`, never raw tokens.

rules.name: The Joined Letters Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing stays at normal on every role so Arabic letters stay joined. Hierarchy comes from size and weight.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Dates, amounts, and any figure that may line up with another use tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: A screen has one raised surface, and it is the ticket. Fields, notices, and buttons do not cast shadows.

rules.name: The Perforation Rule
rules.body: The tear line separates a ticket's identifying stub from its working body. It appears once per ticket and is never used as a generic divider.

dos: **Do** read colors through `AppPalette` roles so each scheme gets its own built value.
**Do** keep one raised surface per screen, carrying `raisedShadow`.
**Do** put every control on the 12dp corner and every border on a 1dp hairline; only focus thickens to 1.6dp.
**Do** keep touch targets at least 48dp and merge a field's visible label into its semantics.
**Do** skip every entrance and transition when the system asks for reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** introduce saturated colors; the error red stays muted and is the only hue outside the slate-navy ladder.
**Don't** use the previous violet tokens (`AppColors.primary` and its siblings, `AppSurfaces`) on a surface that has moved to this world.
**Don't** invert Light to make Dark; each scheme has its own role values.
**Don't** apply negative letter spacing on any role.
**Don't** add shadows to fields, notices, or buttons, or stack a second raised card on the ticket.
**Don't** use the perforation as a plain divider in lists or sections.
**Don't** fade the ticket in on entrance; it rises once, already visible.
